name: color.chart.brand
description: The brand series: the one the reader is asked to look at. The same step in both modes, so a chart weighs the same on either surface.

name: color.chart.neutral
description: A series that is context, not the point: totals, the remainder, last period, the tail folded into Other. Also the threshold line.

name: color.chart.information
description: A series carrying an informational status: in progress, planned.

name: color.chart.success
description: A series carrying a success status: satisfied, closed, on time.

name: color.chart.warning
description: A series carrying a warning status: partial, at risk, due soon.

name: color.chart.danger
description: A series carrying a danger status: other than satisfied, overdue, open.

name: color.chart.track
description: The unfilled part of a ring or bar: the whole against which a series is read.

name: color.chart.categorical.1
description: Categorical series 1, blue. The six hues are in a fixed order that keeps every neighbouring pair apart under deutan and protan vision (validated 2026-09-04); assign in order, never by rank.

name: color.chart.categorical.2
description: Categorical series 2, orange. The six hues are in a fixed order that keeps every neighbouring pair apart under deutan and protan vision (validated 2026-09-04); assign in order, never by rank.

name: color.chart.categorical.3
description: Categorical series 3, teal. The six hues are in a fixed order that keeps every neighbouring pair apart under deutan and protan vision (validated 2026-09-04); assign in order, never by rank.

name: color.chart.categorical.4
description: Categorical series 4, red. The six hues are in a fixed order that keeps every neighbouring pair apart under deutan and protan vision (validated 2026-09-04); assign in order, never by rank.

name: color.chart.categorical.5
description: Categorical series 5, purple. The six hues are in a fixed order that keeps every neighbouring pair apart under deutan and protan vision (validated 2026-09-04); assign in order, never by rank.

name: color.chart.categorical.6
description: Categorical series 6, green. The six hues are in a fixed order that keeps every neighbouring pair apart under deutan and protan vision (validated 2026-09-04); assign in order, never by rank.

name: color.chart.categorical.7
description: Categorical series 7: Other, the fold for every category past the sixth. Grey on purpose, the same as color.chart.neutral.

name: color.chart.categorical.8
description: Deprecated: there is no eighth category. Six hues, then Other (categorical.7).

name: color.chart.sequential.1
description: Sequential step 1 of 5, near zero: one hue, light to dark for how much. Step 1 recedes toward the surface; step 5 is the most.

name: color.chart.sequential.2
description: Sequential step 2 of 5, low: one hue, light to dark for how much. Step 1 recedes toward the surface; step 5 is the most.

name: color.chart.sequential.3
description: Sequential step 3 of 5, middle: one hue, light to dark for how much. Step 1 recedes toward the surface; step 5 is the most.

name: color.chart.sequential.4
description: Sequential step 4 of 5, high: one hue, light to dark for how much. Step 1 recedes toward the surface; step 5 is the most.

name: color.chart.sequential.5
description: Sequential step 5 of 5, the most: one hue, light to dark for how much. Step 1 recedes toward the surface; step 5 is the most.

name: color.chart.diverging.negative
description: Diverging, the negative arm's inner step: a little below the midpoint.

name: color.chart.diverging.negative.bold
description: Diverging, the negative arm's outer step: far below the midpoint. The arm that means below, behind, under, over budget.

name: color.chart.diverging.midpoint
description: Diverging, the midpoint: at the line, nothing to say. Grey, never a hue.

name: color.chart.diverging.positive
description: Diverging, the positive arm's inner step: a little above the midpoint.

name: color.chart.diverging.positive.bold
description: Diverging, the positive arm's outer step: far above the midpoint. Blue against red: warm against cool, so the two arms read as opposites.
